name: ModelVariant154_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant154_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a trail of grid copies flies from a slot part to a point in front of the other slot, a beam of ring segments joins them and rings and grids burst out before a screen flash); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request modulo 100, builds the grid points, packs three texture images and prints the work size, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0, 4 while the trail runs, then 1 once and 2; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-171 and 301 images build it without the work-size printf and with the PAL screen height, so their data names bind 0x24 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
